decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to consistently apply pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and using burn spells to finish them off. The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury providing additional aggression, this Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to enable powerful combos and loops by utilizing artifacts and spells from the graveyard. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and combo potential, while cards like Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble help to fuel the graveyard. The deck also includes disruption and protection in the form of Unholy Heat, Portable Hole, and Spell Pierce. With the right setup, this deck can generate a lot of value and potentially win the game in a single turn.

The main focus of this deck is utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to quickly and efficiently disrupt and control the opponent's board while setting up for a powerful win condition. The deck contains a mix of counter spells, disruption spells, and combo pieces that work together to create a fast and aggressive strategy. By using a variety of different cards, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through careful planning and execution.

The main concept of this deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo without relying on lands. By utilizing cards like Thundertrap Trainer, Fallaji Archaeologist, and Goblin Charbelcher along with various instant and sorcery spells like Sink into Stupor and Disrupting Shoal, players aim to quickly build a dominant board presence and overwhelm opponents. This deck focuses on card advantage and disruptive tactics to control the game while setting up for a game-winning combo. The key strategy is to efficiently use spells and abilities to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to quickly establish a board presence. Support cards such as Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional value and help to push damage through. The deck also includes removal options like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm, as well as disruption cards like Static Prison to control the battlefield. The mana base is streamlined for consistency and efficiency, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and close out games quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The main strategy is to play efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to push for quick damage. The deck has some removal options with cards like Surgical Extraction and Thraben Charm, as well as disruption with Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison. The mana base is optimized for consistent and fast gameplay.

The deck focuses on using ramp strategies to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, while also controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Devourer of Destiny and Kozilek's Command. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Ghost Quarter and Bojuka Bog to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept is to ramp up mana quickly, control the opponent's board, and finish the game with massive Eldrazi creatures.

The focus of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast and aggressive creatures, along with efficient removal and disruptive spells. The deck aims to control the board early on with cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Galvanic Discharge, while also putting pressure on the opponent with cards such as Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury ensures that the deck can close out games quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on assembling a combination of cards to create a powerful engine that can recur key spells from the graveyard, allowing for explosive plays and potentially winning the game in a single turn. The deck utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to generate value and set up game-winning combos, while also incorporating disruptive elements like Portable Hole and Malevolent Rumble to control the game. The goal is to create a loop of casting spells from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off and win the game quickly. It includes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to help set up the combo and dig for combo pieces. The deck also has protection spells like Spell Snare and Swan Song to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The land base includes a variety of fetch lands to help fix mana and Urza's Saga to search for important artifacts. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces, disrupt the opponent, and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to quickly deploy powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It includes cards like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return for removal, while also using Talisman of Impulse and Utopia Sprawl to ramp up mana quickly. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and flexibility. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and overwhelm them with big Eldrazi creatures, allowing for a strong late-game advantage.

This deck focuses on using ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By utilizing mana acceleration, card draw, and removal spells, the goal is to quickly bring out big Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to dominate the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Return to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the game. Overall, the strategy revolves around ramping into big threats and out-valuing the opponent.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with various spells and abilities. By utilizing ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, the deck aims to play big threats such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of control elements like Kozilek's Command and Karn, the Great Creator helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining board presence. The deck excels at turning the tide of the game with its powerful creatures and versatile spells.

The main concept of this Esper Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard manipulation. By using cards like Spell Snare, Force of Negation, and Thought Scour, the deck aims to prevent the opponent from executing their game plan while also fueling the graveyard for cards like Murktide Regent and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck seeks to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent through efficient removal and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful combo using cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Lotus Bloom, while also controlling the game with counterspells like Disrupting Shoal and Flare of Denial. The deck aims to win without relying on traditional lands, utilizing cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Hydroelectric Specimen to generate mana and keep the opponent off balance. With a mix of spell recursion, card draw, and disruption, this deck aims to create a unique and unpredictable playstyle in the Modern format.
